title: jumpscare dance
script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FullScreenAnimation"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- TEXT (TOP)
local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
text.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
text.Text = "by wx00lkid no steal my script skid"
text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
text.TextScaled = true
text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
text.Parent = gui

-- IMAGE
local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
image.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
image.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
image.Parent = gui

-- SOUND
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://128802844460270"
sound.Volume = 9
sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.19
sound.Looped = true
sound.Parent = gui
sound:Play()

-- FRAMES
local frames = {
    "rbxassetid://136485253356525",
    "rbxassetid://136678446046904",
    "rbxassetid://111455670720714"
}

local fps = 12

while true do
    for i = 1, #frames do
        image.Image = frames[i]
        task.wait(1 / fps)
    end
end
